newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Roche 1996 net profits, dividend higher.
newsitem.headline: Roche 1996 net profits, dividend higher.

text.p: Pharmaceutical giant Roche Holding AG said on Monday 1996 net profit rose 16 percent to 3.899 billion Swiss francs ($2.7 billion), at the lower end of analyst's forecasts.
Roche said it would propose a dividend of 75 Swiss francs, up 11 francs from the year before and the tenth dividend increase in a row.
The consensus forecast had been for a 17.6 percent rise in 1996 profit to 3.97 billion francs.
Roche did not publish any other details ahead of an annual news conference on April 15.
It had reported in January that 1996 turnover was 15.96 billion Swiss francs, up from 14.43 billion the year before.

Roche has remained a favourite in the Swiss pharma sector despite fanfare surrounding new rival Novartis AG, backed by a solid earnings stream in past years, some 23 new products in the latter stages of clinical trials and a cash pile of some 15 billion francs.
